transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my wife thought it would be a good idea for me to come in. We've been having some disagreements about... things. 

She says her late meetings and, you know, the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... I don't know. For the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It’s... it feels like there’s some kind of private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t just say directly. 

So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Do you really believe your wife is sending you hidden messages through her work messages?

I mean... yes. Like I just said, she claims it's all just normal work stuff. But... if you actually look at it over the last year, it's just too precise. The late meetings, the specific way she words things... it's not an accident. 

It's a signal. I just... I think she's trying to tell me something, and she just won't come out and say it to my face.
Do you think it's possible that you're misinterpreting your wife's work messages?

I... no. I don't think I am. 

I know she says it's just normal office stuff. But... I've been paying attention for a year now. Things don't just line up that precisely by accident. It... it feels like a private signal. She's just not saying it directly. So, no... I'm not misinterpreting it.
Do you think these hidden messages are meant for you specifically, or could they be meant for someone else?
I... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it being for anyone else. I just... I don't really want to get into all of that right now.
Do you think it's possible that you could be wrong about these hidden messages?

I... no. I mean, we kind of just went over this. 

I know she claims the late meetings and the little changes in her messages are just normal office stuff. But... looking at it over the past year, it just lines up too precisely to be an accident. It's a private signal. It's just something she won't say directly to me. 

So... no. I don't really see how I could be wrong about it.
Do you think these messages are about you, specifically?
I... I don't really know. We kind of just went over this a minute ago. I haven't... I just don't want to get into all the specifics right now. Can we just move on from this?
Do you think your wife's messages are related to you or something you've done?
I... look, I don't know. I haven't done anything to cause it, if that's what you're asking. I just... I'd really rather not keep picking this apart right now. We're just going in circles.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your interpretation of your wife's messages might change over time?

I... I don't see why it would change. We keep coming back to this. 

Like I already told you, this has been going on for the past year. She keeps saying the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... they just line up too precisely to be an accident. It's a private signal. She's trying to tell me something she won't just say directly. 

So, no. I don't think time is going to change what I'm seeing. I really... I don't want to keep repeating myself on this.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't think your wife was sending you hidden messages?

I mean... yeah. Before last year. 

It's... this has just been going on for about a year. Ever since she started working outside the home again. Before that, no. But... I think we've already covered the timeline. I'd really rather not keep going over it.
Have you ever had any doubts about your interpretation of your wife's messages?

I... no. Not really. 

I know she says it's just normal office stuff. The late meetings, the way she phrases things in those messages. She says it's nothing. But... I told you, it's been a year of this. They line up too precisely. It doesn't feel accidental. It's... it's a private signal. She's trying to tell me something she won't just say directly. 

So... no. I don't doubt it. I just... I don't want to keep talking about this.
Have you ever had a time, even for a short period, where you didn't believe your wife was sending you hidden messages since this started a year ago?

No. I... I haven't. 

Like I just said, this has been going on for about a year... ever since she started working outside the home again. It hasn't stopped during that time. It's just been constant. I really... I don't have anything else to add to that.
Have you ever had a moment, even briefly, where you questioned the existence of these hidden messages since they started a year ago?

I feel like we just went over this. No. I haven't. 

Look... I know she says the late meetings and the little changes in her messages are just normal office stuff. But they line up too precisely to be an accident. It's a private signal. She's trying to tell me something she won't say directly. 

I... I really don't want to keep repeating myself.
Have you ever had a break or a period where you didn't think about these hidden messages for a while?

I... no. I haven't. 

I don't know how many different ways you want me to say this. Like I told you, it's been about a year of this. Ever since she started that new job outside the house. It's... it's just been there the whole time. I don't get a break from it.
Has there ever been a time when you didn't think about these hidden messages for an entire day?

No. I... we just keep going in circles here. 

Like I've been saying, it's been a year. Ever since she went back to work. I don't... it doesn't just stop for a whole day. I really don't have anything else to say about the timeline.
Have you ever had a moment where you didn't believe in the hidden messages?

No. I... I really don't understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. 

I've already told you. She claims the late meetings and the... the subtle shifts in how she texts from work are just normal office stuff. But they aren't. They line up too perfectly. It's been a year of this, and it's obvious to me that it's a private signal. She's trying to communicate something she won't just come out and say. 

I don't know why I have to keep defending this. I haven't changed my mind.
Has anything significant happened in your life or your wife's life around the time these hidden messages started?
I... didn't I just say that? She took the new job. That's... that's it. I don't know of anything else. Just the job.
Did your wife's new job cause any significant changes or stress in your relationship?

Well... yes. There's been tension. We... we have a lot of tense conversations at home about it. 

That's actually why I'm here. We were seeing a couples therapist, and they eventually suggested I come in for an individual assessment. So... here I am. 

But it's just between us. I haven't had any problems at work, and I'm keeping up with my usual routines just fine. It's really just the marriage.
Has anything or anyone ever been able to change your mind about the hidden messages, even temporarily?

No. I... I feel like we just went over this. 

Nothing has changed my mind. I know she says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... like I said, for the past year, they’ve lined up too precisely to be accidental. It's a private signal. It's meant to tell me something she won't say directly. 

So, no. No one has changed my mind. I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Has your belief in the hidden messages ever wavered, even for a brief moment, since it started?

I really feel like we're going in circles here. No. It hasn't wavered. 

Like I just told you... I know she claims the late meetings and the little changes in her messages are just normal office stuff. But it's been a year of this. It lines up too precisely to be an accident. It's a private signal... it's meant to tell me something she just won't say directly. 

So, no. I haven't doubted it. I don't know how else to answer that.
